picks.title: The Mori Is a Mushroom-Shaped AI Lamp Companion, and I'm Smitten
picks.rationale: New device hands-on: the $849 Mori is a camera-equipped AI companion disguised as a mushroom lamp that reads its surroundings to decide when to engage. It shows home-robot design pushed toward ambient decor.
picks.excerpt: The $849 Mori is designed to respond to your environment, knowing when to play and when to stay quiet.

picks.title: Meta Expands SDKs To Boost Spatial Apps On Quest & VR Glasses, Including NBA, Disney+
picks.rationale: New platform release: Meta ships spatial-app SDKs for Quest and its AI glasses, including a VR Layout SDK built to be implemented by an AI coding agent. This changes how designers prototype spatial UI tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Meta announced new SDKs for spatial apps on Quest and its VR/AI glasses, including a VR Layout SDK it says is optimized to be implemented by an AI coding agent, alongside NBA and Disney+ spatial updates.

picks.title: AMD's FSR 4.1 now works on Radeon RX 6000 GPUs, Xbox Series X and S, and Ryzen AI Max, AI 9, and Z2 SoCs — new release brings cutting-edge tech to older hardware with a small performance cost
picks.rationale: New release: AMD's ML-based FSR 4.1 upscaler now runs on RX 6000 GPUs, Xbox Series consoles and Ryzen AI SoCs. On-device AI image reconstruction reaches hardware people already own.
picks.excerpt: AMD gives older GPUs an image quality boost amid the ongoing AI chip drought

picks.title: I changed one llama.cpp flag, and my 8GB laptop GPU now runs a 35B model faster than I can read
picks.rationale: Actionable on-device AI technique: offloading MoE layers to system RAM with one llama.cpp flag lets an ordinary 8GB laptop GPU run a 35B local model at reading speed. No new hardware needed.
picks.excerpt: XDA shows how offloading mixture-of-experts layers to system RAM with a single llama.cpp flag lets an 8GB laptop GPU run a 35B local LLM faster than reading speed.

picks.title: Birdbuddy's Nook is a compact smart bird feeder for small spaces and budgets
picks.rationale: New device launch: Birdbuddy's Nook is a smaller, cheaper 2K-camera feeder with AI species identification. Camera-plus-AI home devices are moving down to entry-level prices.
picks.excerpt: The Birdbuddy Nook makes smart feeders more accessible to novice bird-watchers.
